message:
Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/bnd.s <<'EOF'
.intel_syntax noprefix
.global _start
_start:
  bndcl bnd0, eax
  bndcl bnd0, [eax]
  bndmov bnd0, bnd1
  bndmov bnd0, [eax]
  bndmk bnd0, [eax]
EOF
as --32 /tmp/bnd.s -o /tmp/bnd.o && objdump -d -Mintel /tmp/bnd.o && objcopy -O binary -j .text /tmp/bnd.o /tmp/bnd.bin && xxd -g1 /tmp/bnd.bin
